payload.summary: perthCalendarDate is a third independent Perth-date implementation in this repo
payload.detail: src/lib/cme/cpd-year.ts's perthCalendarDate uses the en-CA Intl trick to get a YYYY-MM-DD Perth date. src/lib/caring-contacts/clock.ts and src/components/ui/date-display.tsx each already do the same job their own way. All three are currently correct — the en-CA behaviour was verified on this Node version, and the leap-year arithmetic matches Intl's own Perth calendar for 2028 — so nothing is broken. But it is the third copy, each with its own tests pinning its own behaviour, and the fourth author to need a Perth date will write a fourth. Collapsing them was deliberately NOT done in PR #2902: it drags an unrelated clinical feature (caring-contacts) and a shared UI primitive into a change already at seventy files, for no behaviour change.
